question: Which of the following cities is known as “The Queen of the Arabian Sea'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kochi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kochi is known as the 'Queen of the Arabian Sea'**__.

 __
 
• It was the **centre of the Indian spice trade for many centuries**.
 
• Kochi was the centre of the Indian spice trade for many centuries and was known to the Yavanas (Greeks and Romans) as well as Jews, Syrians, Arabs, and Chinese since ancient times.
